title: Retry rollback: revert app to the previous version (undo latest VAT priority logic changes)

requirements.text: Revert the application behavior to the version immediately prior to the latest deployment draft (the draft that introduced the new/updated “VAT priority logic”). This rollback must restore the previous VAT/invoice flow behavior and UI outputs as they were before the latest VAT-priority changes were applied.

quotes: Amend the app, revert back to the previous version

acceptanceCriteria: Running the VAT calculator + invoice flow produces the same VAT rate/label/amount outcomes as the previous version (i.e., before the last VAT priority-logic changes).
No newly introduced VAT-priority-specific labels or outcomes (e.g., any newly added precedence behavior) appear if they did not exist in the prior version.
The app builds successfully without TypeScript errors (frontend) and Motoko compilation errors (backend).

requirements.text: Ensure the rollback does not break access to already-saved invoices. Existing invoice records must remain listable and viewable after the rollback (including any fields currently stored on backend invoice records such as currency and VAT label).

quotes: Amend the app, revert back to the previous version

acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, a user with existing invoices can open the Invoices page and see prior invoices listed without runtime errors.
Opening/downloading an existing invoice record does not trap on missing fields and does not require manual data resets.
No state-wiping reinstall mode is required for this rollback.

requirements.text: Update deployment verification to clearly indicate the rolled-back build version via the existing production marker mechanism, so that operators can confirm rollback in the browser console after deployment.

quotes: Amend the app, revert back to the previous version

acceptanceCriteria: In production mode, the browser console marker reflects the rolled-back release identifier (e.g., the previous marker/version), allowing easy verification that rollback is deployed.
The production publish checklist remains consistent with the production marker output used for verification.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing new VAT logic or additional VAT scenarios beyond what existed in the previous version.
Adding new payment features, new analytics features, or new UI pages unrelated to the rollback.
Introducing schema-breaking changes that require wiping state.
